backcard_card_name: King Cold, Ruler of the Galactic Dynasty
backcard_card_text:
[Permanent] When activating a [Field] skill of a green Extra Card with an original energy cost of 2 from your hand, reduce that card's energy cost by 1.
[Auto][Once per turn] When you activate a green Extra Card with an original energy cost of 2 and the [Field] skill, draw 1 card.
[Activate : Battle][Once per turn] Choose 1 green Extra Card with an energy cost of 2 and the [Field] skill in your Battle Area and place it in its owner's Drop Area : This card gets +10000 power for the battle.
card_text:
[Permanent] When activating a [Field] skill of a green Extra Card with an original energy cost of 2 from your hand, reduce that card's energy cost by 1.
[Auto] When this card is placed in your Leader Area, activate up to 1 {King Cold's Dynasty} from your deck.
[Auto][Once per turn] When you activate a green Extra Card with an original energy cost of 2 and the [Field] skill, add up to 1 card from your life to your hand and draw 1 card.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less : You may switch up to 2 of your energy to Active Mode and flip this card over.
